verdict.rationale: Multi-entity management with consolidated financials is a fair question for an accounting system, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions multiple legal entities, intercompany handling, or consolidated reporting in Mercury Books. Its reports (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet) are described only for a single business. Classes apply only to QuickBooks/NetSuite integrations and are an adjacent feature, not entity consolidation.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them
